stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: At the temple, Rogue copies the wounded Kitty's power and takes her place holding Logan's mind in the past.
stages.whoA: Takes her place holding Logan's mind in the past.
stages.whoB: A wounded X-Man whose power she copies.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: On Xavier's museum trip, Bobby puts out a fire John starts and Xavier freezes the room to end it. At Alkali Lake, Bobby and Rogue fly the X-Jet in to pick up Xavier and the others.
stages.whoA: A student who flies the jet in to rescue him.
stages.whoB: His teacher. Takes his class to a museum.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When Kitty is hurt, Bobby tells Xavier that Rogue is held in Cerebro and could take her place. Xavier agrees to the rescue and guides Bobby into the old mansion.
stages.whoA: A former student he guides on the rescue of Rogue.
stages.whoB: His old teacher. Agrees to his plan to save Rogue.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At Alcatraz, Bobby's ice wall stops Magneto's charging Brotherhood, and Magneto lets Pyro go down to finish him.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who stops his Brotherhood at Alcatraz.
stages.whoB: Sends Pyro after him at Alcatraz.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Magneto and Bobby break into the old mansion together to free Rogue. Bobby stays behind to hold off the Sentinels so Magneto can get her out.
stages.whoA: An X-Man who covers his escape with Rogue.
stages.whoB: An old enemy he breaks into the mansion with.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Bobby fights the Sentinels to buy time for his friends, and they kill him.
stages.whoA: Robots that kill him.
stages.whoB: An X-Man they kill.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Rogue is held prisoner in Cerebro at the old mansion. Sentinels attack as she escapes, and another strikes the X-Jet as she boards.
stages.whoA: Robots that guard her prison and hunt her down.
stages.whoB: A captive mutant who escapes them.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When Logan's mind slips and he wounds Kitty, Magneto holds him down so she can keep his mind in the past.
stages.whoA: Holds Logan down after he wounds her.
stages.whoB: The X-Man keeping Logan's mind in the past.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When Xavier lays out his plan to send Logan back to 1973, Bishop argues against it, since some of them may never be born. Xavier and Storm talk him round.
stages.whoA: Doubts his plan, then backs it.
stages.whoB: Talks him into a plan that may erase him.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Blink sides with Bishop against Xavier's plan to send Logan back to 1973, until Xavier and Storm win her over.
stages.whoA: Doubts his plan, then backs it.
stages.whoB: Wins her over to his plan to change the past.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Sunspot sides with Bishop against Xavier's plan to send Logan back to 1973, until Xavier and Storm win him over.
stages.whoA: Doubts his plan, then backs it.
stages.whoB: Wins him over to his plan to change the past.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Storm helps Xavier talk Bishop round when he argues against sending Logan back to 1973.
stages.whoA: Argues against the plan until she talks him round.
stages.whoB: Helps talk him into Xavier's plan.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Storm helps Xavier win Blink over when she sides with Bishop against sending Logan back to 1973.
stages.whoA: Doubts the plan until she wins her over.
stages.whoB: Helps win her over to Xavier's plan.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Storm helps Xavier win Sunspot over when he sides with Bishop against sending Logan back to 1973.
stages.whoA: Doubts the plan until she wins him over.
stages.whoB: Helps win him over to Xavier's plan.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Betty interviews Flash about Peter for the school news, and he claims he gave Spider-Man his name.
stages.whoA: A classmate who claims he named Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: A classmate who interviews him for the school news.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: As Logan prepares to go back to 1973, Bishop warns him that changing history could mean some of them are never born.
stages.whoA: Warns him that changing history could erase them.
stages.whoB: The X-Man sent back to change history.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When Sunspot asks if they are being told to give up their lives for a future they may not be part of, Magneto answers yes.
stages.whoA: Balks at giving his life for the plan.
stages.whoB: Tells him the plan is worth his life.

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Wesley insults Foggy at the Natchios party. Later Foggy works out that the initials found in a murdered woman's apartment are Wesley's, tying him to the killing.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin's aide. Tied to a murder by him.
stages.whoB: A lawyer who ties him to a murder.

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Foggy calls Ben at the morgue with the name of the man behind his informant's murder, the Kingpin's aide Wesley.
stages.whoA: A reporter he tips off about Wesley.
stages.whoB: Matt's partner. Tells him who killed his informant.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May brings Otto to Happy's apartment to be cured and asks whether he would like fresh water or salt, since he is part octopus. She watches proudly as Peter's new chip gives him back control.
stages.whoA: A visitor Peter cures at Happy's apartment.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt. Takes him in to be cured.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May brings Max to Happy's apartment to be cured, but he sides with the Goblin and knocks out the building's power, stopping the elevators as she runs to help Peter.
stages.whoA: A visitor she tries to help. Turns on her and Peter.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt. Takes him in to be cured.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May brings Flint to Happy's apartment to be cured, but he slips away when the Goblin turns the others against Peter.
stages.whoA: A visitor she tries to help. Flees when the Goblin strikes.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt. Takes him in to be cured.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May drives Curt to Happy's apartment with the other visitors to be cured, but he tells her he will wait in the F.E.A.S.T. truck.
stages.whoA: A visitor she drives to be cured.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt. Drives him to Happy's apartment.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Peter meets Rosie when he visits Otto, and she joins their talk about his fusion work. She is killed at the demonstration Peter attends.
stages.whoA: Otto's wife. Killed at his demonstration.
stages.whoB: A young student who visits Otto.
